message.content:
**MSFT** is the ticker symbol for **Microsoft Corporation** on major stock exchanges (NASDAQ).  
On Yahoo Finance you can view its data by searching “MSFT” or by visiting:

[https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/MSFT](https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/MSFT)

This page shows the latest price, historical charts, financial statements, news, and analyst estimates for Microsoft.
